## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 19-fascicle Northern-Sòng sub-commentary on [灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Dà bān niè pán jīng shū* 大般涅槃經疏 ([KR6g0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0007)) is by [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) Zhìyuán, the *Shānwài* Tiāntái-school master. The "three virtues" (*sān dé* 三德) of the title refers to the *Nièpán jīng*'s threefold doctrine of *fǎ shēn* / *bān ruò* / *jiě tuō* (Dharma-body, wisdom, liberation).

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (990–1022) reflects Zhìyuán's mature scholarly activity. The 19-fascicle scope makes this one of the largest Sòng-period sub-commentaries.
